body:
I'll start by examining the assigned files and the reference style.

Now writing the compressed chapters.

All five chapters revised, verified, and within target.

## Final sizes (`wc -c`)
| File | Bytes |
|---|---:|
| `19-upgrade-and-maintenance.md` | 7,168 |
| `20-decisions-and-pitfalls.md` | 7,194 |
| `21-quick-reference.md` | 7,171 |
| `22-recommended-implementation.md` | 7,199 |
| `23-coverage-and-limits.md` | 6,975 |

## Checks run
- `## Sources` count = 1 in every file; it is the last `##` heading and nothing follows it.
- Every `path:line` / short `:NNN` citation parsed and resolved under `/tmp/litellm-src` (0 problems), and each resolved line's text inspected (`--skip_server_startup`, `/key/regenerate`, `migrationJob:`, `num_retries`, `PROXY_BATCH_WRITE_AT`, etc. all match their claims). `litellm/proxy/health_endpoints/_health_endpoints.py:2333,2440` and `docker-entrypoint.sh:1-26` checked by hand.
- English only; titles `# NN — Title`; single scope line where kept; no tables/code blocks beyond reference style (the two YAML/install blocks are the primary recipes).

## Deliberate drops (facts still covered elsewhere in the guide)
- **19:** "image exposes a `migrations` component" + `docker-entrypoint.sh:110-112` (component table lives in `02`); trailing editorial "do not assume the documented boundary away" (license fact retained); `docker_image_security`, `prod`, `health`, `prisma_migrations` dropped from the Sources list only — still inline-cited.
- **20:** `§10` rows "In-memory limits" and "Same config, different pods" (duplicated by `§4` rate-limit/budget text and `§5` 30 s poll); `users.md`, `prod.md`, `missing_model.md` removed from the Sources list (still inline).
- **21:** image-components block (`02`), `--detailed_debug` (documented in `14`), `--use_prisma_db_push`, `GET /health/backlog`, the inspect-curl block (`/key/info`, `/health/readiness` remain in the endpoint table), `request_timeout`/`set_verbose` in the skeleton, `ui.md` from Sources.
- **22:** ASCII topology diagram replaced by an equivalent 3-bullet topology; `model_info.id` stanzas and `request_timeout` removed from the YAML (router `timeout: 600` kept); sufficiency items "add a model without restarting" and "keep prompts out of logs" removed as duplicates of `§4` prose and `§7` checklist (the Redis question remains via the RPM item and `§9`); `configs.md`, `health.md`, `redis_requirements.md`, `master_key_rotations.md` dropped from Sources.
- **23:** coverage table merged 17 → 15 rows; duplicate salt-key citation collapsed to `prod.md`; `ui.md` removed from the Sources list (inline cited).

Not run: the global verifier (siblings still editing).
